newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine economic zones investments climb.
newsitem.headline: Philippine economic zones investments climb.

text.p: Total approved investments in special economic zones in the Philippines for the first five and a half months of the year rose to 91.9 million pesos from 14.12 million in the same period last year, officials said on Sunday.

Documents released by the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) showed there were 14 new enterprises set up during the first five and a half months of 1997 compared with six during the same period in 1996.
Investors in the economic zones enjoy income tax holidays and preferential duties for capital imports.
